dataset.reference_kind: Manually inspected MANO fits; not independent optical-marker ground truth
dataset.crop: Dataset-provided 224x224 hand crops; no full-image person/hand detection evaluated
dataset.units: Metres inferred from the shared FreiHAND/MANO convention; no bone-length alignment
dataset.projection: Frame-specific K times M_world_to_camera; official crop example applies no extra distortion

rotation_selection: Maximum model hand-presence, independent of reference coordinates

artificial_all_view_gap.selection: First manually validated frame with two preceding fitted frames, selected before inference

limitations: One tester sequence is not a held-out population benchmark; model training overlap is unknown.
Only manually validated reference frames count toward errors; all frames supply causal history.
Eight-way rotation search on known hand crops is a component evaluation, not the whole-body ROI pipeline.
Eight-view reconstruction is an upper-bound diagnostic; the published app accepts two views.
MANO-fit agreement is not independently measured physical finger accuracy.
Presence is a shared hand-level model score, not per-finger visibility ground truth.
Fixed gray rectangles and omitted observations are artificial corruption, not labeled natural occlusion.
No body, instep or toe reference is included; browser throughput is not measured.
Original images, references and calibration arrays are excluded from public artifacts.
timing_origin: CPU image timings are from the original image-inference run, not this geometry-only evaluation.

pair_selection.name: selected_two_views_from_warmup
pair_selection.scope: Placement diagnostic among eight recorded candidates, not automatic placement of a two-camera app.

methods.holdLast: Causal last accepted input coordinate; expires at the product free-prediction age for each joint group.

provenance.coordinateConversion: No conversion: native coordinates treated as metres under the inherited FreiHAND/MANO convention.
provenance.unitStatus: Inference from the shared convention, not a direct HanCo statement of SI units.
provenance.reference: Only manually inspected MANO fits are scored; no independent optical-marker reference.
provenance.input: Dataset-provided hand crops with eight fixed rotation candidates, selected by model presence.

pairSelection.objective: Sum of product triangulation confidence / all declared joint-frames in the warmup.
pairSelection.scoring: Warmup observations initialize history; their reference points are excluded from the added comparisons.

geometry.scope: Known-crop hand inference followed by the product triangulation and causal tracker; two-view comparison and eight-view upper-bound diagnostic.
limitations: Reference coordinates are consumed for scoring and are not included in this report.
Artificial observation-drop removes observations after inference or reconstruction; it is not an image-occlusion benchmark.
MPJPE is conditional on an available estimate. Coverage and PCK use all valid GT joints.
This sequence does not establish performance on user cameras or every type of occlusion.
Reference coordinates are consumed for scoring and are not included in this report.
Artificial observation-drop removes observations after inference or reconstruction; it is not an image-occlusion benchmark.
MPJPE is conditional on an available estimate. Coverage and PCK use all valid GT joints.
This sequence does not establish performance on user cameras or every type of occlusion.
Known hand crop plus eight-direction search does not evaluate the product whole-body-to-hand ROI pipeline.
Eight-view reconstruction is a diagnostic; the published app accepts two views.
Training-data overlap is unknown; this does not establish unseen-data generalization.
Reported millimetres express agreement with MANO fits under the inherited metre convention, not independently measured physical accuracy.
Placement diagnostic among eight recorded candidates, not automatic placement of a two-camera app.
